title: Kick Off to the Future
description:
JICA bekerjasama  dengan Liga Sepak Bola Profesional Jepang (J League) dan Urawa Red Diamonds mendatangkan Seiichiro Maki, mantan pesepakbola profesional Jepang yang juga pernah menjadi bagian dari tim nacional Jepang pada Piala Dunia tahun 2006, untuk acara ‘Kick Off to the Future’ yang diadakan di sebuah lapangan sepak bola di wilayah Kabupaten Sigi, Sulawesi Tengah.

Mari ikuti perjalanannya untuk kegiatan yang bertujuan untuk pemulihan trauma dan edukasi mengenai bencana khususnya untuk anak-anak yang sampai dengan saat ini masih berada di lokasi-lokasi pengungsian.


Jangan lupa untuk Like, Comment, Subscribe, dan Share videonya ya!

================================================================

JICA in cooperation with Japan Professional Football League (J League) and Urawa Red Diamonds dispatched Mr. Seiichiro Maki, a former Japanese footballer, who also played for Japan National Team at 2006 World Cup, for ‘Kick Off to the Future’ event at a soccer field in the Sigi Regency Area, Central Sulawesi.

Let’s follow his journey for the event which aimed for trauma healing and disaster education especially for children who still live in the evacuation shelters.

Don't forget to Like, Comment, Subscribe, and Share!

title: JICA Hadir di Jak-Japan Matsuri 2019 -- JICA in Jak-Japan Matsuri 2019
description:
-English follows Bahasa Indonesia-

Pada Jak-Japan Matsuri 2019 yang berlangsung di Jakarta, 7 & 8 September 2019, JICA hadir dengan mengusung tema ‘Build Back Better’. 

Booth JICA menampilkan beragam informasi yang berkaitan dengan tema tersebut, permainan tembak-tembakan bertemakan tanda bencana, serta yang lainnya, dengan harapan para pengunjung yang datang ke booth JICA memahami pentingnya pengelolaan bencana dan konsep ‘Build Back Better’ .

Selain itu, 8 September 2019, di booth JICA diadakan talk-show untuk mengedukasi pengunjung terhadap bencana yang terjadi di Sulawesi Tengah, akhir September 2018, yang menghadirkan juga musisi Hiroaki Kato.

==

At the Jak-Japan Matsuri 2019, which took place in Jakarta on 7 & 8 September 2019, JICA introduced the concept of ‘Build Back Better’. 

JICA booth displayed various information related to the theme, a shooting game with ‘Disaster Information Signs’ theme, etc, so by visiting JICA booth, the visitors were expected to understand the importance of disaster management and the concept of ‘Build Back Better’.

Then, on 8 September 2019, JICA held a mini talk-show to disseminate information in relation with the disaster occurred in Central Sulawesi in September 2018, which also participated by musician Hiroaki Kato. 

Dont forget to Like, Comment, Subscribe, and Share!

title: LIVE AID FOR PALU BERSAMA HIROAKI KATO/LIVE AID FOR PALU WITH HIROAKI KATO
description:
Pasca bencana gempa bumi berkekuatan 7,4M yang diikuti dengan tsunami, dan likuifaksi di Sulawesi Tengah pada 28 September 2018 silam, JICA, bersama Hiroaki Kato mengadakan sebuah kegiatan Untuk mengenang sekaligus menyemangati masyarakat Palu, Sigi, dan Donggala yang bernama Live Aid Palu dengan konsep Build Back Better.

Jangan lupa untuk Like, Comment, Subscribe, dan Share videonya ya!

==

After the 7.4M earthquake followed by the tsunami, and the liquefaction inCentral Sulawesi on 28 September 2018, JICA, together with Hiroaki Kato held an event to commemorate and encourage the people of Palu, Sigi, and Donggala called Live Aid Palu with the concept of Build Back Better.

Dont forget to Like, Comment, Subscribe, and Share!

title: BERSAMA MEMBANGUN KEMBALI SULAWESI TENGAH/ BUILD BACK CENTRAL SULAWESI
description:
Setelah gempa bumi berkekuatan 7,4M diikuti dengan tsunami, dan likuifaksi terjadi di Kota Palu, dan sekitarnya pada 28 September 2018, JICA menyediakan bantuan tanggap darurat serta mengirimkan tim untuk melakukan penelaahan kondisi lapangan pada area yang terkena dampak bencana. Setelah itu, BAPPENAS menyusun Rencana Induk (Master Plan) pemulihan 
dan pembangunan kembali Provinsi Sulawesi Tengah paska bencana dengan dukungan dari JICA, yang ditindak lanjuti dengan pendampingan dengan konsep Build Back Better.

Dont forget to Like, Comment, Subscribe, and Share!

==

After the 7.4M earthquake followed by a tsunami, and liquefaction occurred in Palu City and its surrounding cities on 28 September 2018, JICA provided emergency response assistance and dispatched a field survey team to the affected areas. After that, BAPPENAS drafted a Master Plan for the rehabilitation and reconstruction of Central Sulawesi Province with support from JICA, which was followed by cooperation with Build Back Better concept.

Dont forget to Like, Comment, Subscribe, and Share!

title: Ep. 5: Towards an Open Asia: Contribution to the International Community (English)
description:
Indonesia is now within reach of joining upper-middle income countries. JICA is actively supporting Indonesia in enhancing the country’s capacities to address challenges of Asia and the international community.

In this episode we will look at JICA’s cooperation in response to global issues such as environmental issues and infectious diseases; the security of Southeast Asia such as maritime safety and cybersecurity; and South-South and Triangular Cooperation in which Indonesia and Japan together provides assistance to other developing countries.

Let's take a look at each and stay tuned for the upcoming videos!

title: Ep. 4: Menurunkan Kesenjangan dan Mewujudkan Keamanan Masyarakat (Bahasa Indonesia)
description:
JICA telah  terlibat dalam berbagai proyek untuk mendukung pembangunan sosial dan ekonomi Indonesia.

Ketika berbicara tentang kerja sama ekonomi dengan Jepang, barangkali kesan pertama yang kuat adalah bahwa kerjasama di sektor infrastruktur saja. Namun, sebenarnya kerja sama Jepang untuk mengurangi kesenjangan wilayah dalam rangka mewujudkan tatanan masyarakat yang aman dan nyaman.

Pada episode kali ini kita akan melihat kerja sama JICA di berbagai sektor yang lansung berkaitan dengan kehidupan masyarakat, seperti pembangunan wilayah, pertanian, pendidikan dan kesehatan, serta program untuk mewujudkan masyarakat dimana semua orang dapat hidup dengan damai.

Selamat menyaksikan dan nantikan episode berikutnya dalam waktu dekat ini!

title: Ep. 2 : Berjalan Bersama sebagai Mitra Penanggulangan Bencana (Bahasa Indonesia)
description:
Seperti halnya Jepang, Indonesia adalah negara yang rawan dengan berbagai bencana alam. Dibandingkan negara-negara lainnya, Jepang memiliki pemahaman yang lebih terkait penanggulangan bencana. Jepang juga telah menyediakan bantuan terkait kesiapsiagaan bencana dan penanganan darurat serta rekonstruksi pasca bencana di Indonesia.

Pada episode kali ini kita akan melihat lebih dalam lagi tentang bagaimana Indonesia dan Jepang saling bekerjasama dalam menanggulangi bencana.

Nantikan episode berikutnya dalam waktu dekat ini!

title: Ep  1   Indonesia’s Development and Japan’s Cooperation   60 Years and Beyond
description:
During 60 years of Indonesia-Japan diplomatic relations, Japan has provided a number of technical cooperation projects, ODA loan and grant aid projects for the development of Indonesia, making Japan as the biggest development partner for Indonesia.

In this episode we will look deeper into three aspects, namely history, partnership, and innovation that underlie this strong relation between the two countries.

The next episode is coming soon!

title: Ep. 1 : Pembangunan Indonesia dan Kerjasama Jepang : 60 Tahun dan ke Depannya (Bahasa Indonesia)
description:
Selama 60 tahun hubungan diplomatik Indonesia-Jepang , Jepang telah berkontribusi dalam berbagai program kerjasama pembangunan di berbagai wilayah di Indonesia melalui proyek-proyek kerjasama teknis, pinjaman yen, dan proyek-proyek bantuan hibah, sehingga Jepang menjadi mitra pembangunan terbesar bagi Indonesia.

Dalam episode ini kita akan melihat lebih dalam lagi melalui tiga aspek, yaitu sejarah, kemitraan, dan inovasi, yang mendasari hubungan yang erat antara kedua negara ini.

Nantikan episode berikutnya dalam waktu dekat ini!

title: 60 Tahun Hubungan Diplomatik Indonesia-Jepang : Indonesia dan Jepang, Maju Bersama (in Bahasa)
description:
Untuk memperingati 60 tahun hubungan diplomatik Indonesia-Jepang di 2018, JICA mengadakan studi untuk meninjau berbagai kerjasama yang telah dan tengah dilaksanakan, yang dituangkan dalam 5 bagian video terpisah.

description:
Commemorating the 60th anniversary of Indonesia-Japan diplomatic relations in 2018, JICA conducted a study to review various cooperation that has been completed and/or currently still on-going, and produced 5 part of videos as the result.
The following video is the trailer of some of those videos.

title: What We Learned from Tsunami/ Pembelajaran dari Tsunami
description:
When the tsunami hit the coastal area of Indian Ocean on 2004, many people lost their lives, family members, houses, this tragedy have left a very devastating memory on the people, not just from the residents of the area, but also from people all over the world.

Then on 2015, at the 70th Session of the United Nations General Assembly Plenary Meeting held in New York ‘World Tsunami Awareness Day’ on Nov. 5 was established in order to enhance awareness of tsunami disasters and recognize the significance of preparedness for disasters through early warning system.  
 
To commemorate the establishment of ‘World Tsunami Awareness Day’, JICA in cooperation with the city of Aceh held ‘Aceh Seminar on Tsunami Preparedness on 3-5 Nov 2016. 

=======
Ketika tsunami melanda wilayah pesisir Samudra Hindia  tahun 2004, banyak orang kehilangan nyawa, anggota keluarga dan rumah mereka, tragedi ini telah meninggalkan kenangan buruk bagi banyak orang, tidak hanya penduduk daerah yang terkena bencana, namun juga masyarakat di seluruh dunia.

Kemudian pada tahun 2015, dalam rapat pleno PBB ke-70 di New York , menetapkan tanggal 5 November sebagai 'Hari Kesiapsiagaan Tsunami Dunia', dengan tujuan untuk meningkatkan kesadaran akan bencana tsunami dan pentingnya kesiapan menghadapi bencana melalui sistem peringatan dini.

Untuk memperingati ‘Hari Kesiapsiagaan Tsunami Dunia’, pada 3-5 November 2016, JICA bekerja sama dengan Pemerintah Kota Banda Aceh mengadakan ‘Seminar Aceh tentang Kesiapsiagaan Menghadapi Tsunami’.

title: BENTUK CINTA IBU UNTUK SI KECIL
description:
"Buku Kesehatan Ibu dan Anak menunjukkan keinginan kuat seorang ibu untuk memperhatikan kesehatan dan pertumbuhan anaknya. Buku ini mengandung harapan tulus dari seorang ibu agar kehidupan anaknya tidak akan sia-sia, "kata Perdana Menteri Shinzo Abe di pidatonya di Rapat Umum ke- Tujuh Puluh Satu Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa di New York, 29 September 2015. 

Buku KIA yang juga dikenal dengan nama Buku Pink, dikembangkan di Indonesia sejak 1994 atas kerjasama Kementrian Kesehatan RI dan JICA.

Buku ini memiliki dua keistimewaan utama, yakni menjadi satu-satunya alat pencatatan kesehatan Ibu (pada saat hamil, bersalin dan nifas) dan Anak (bayi baru lahir sampai anak usia 6 tahun) yang disimpan di rumah. Serta memuat berbagai informasi cara memelihara dan merawat kesehatan ibu dan anak.

Tidak saja di Indonesia, buku ini juga telah dikembangkan di hampir 40 negara lainnya di dunia dan memiliki satu tujuan utama, yaitu meningkatkan kesehatan ibu dan anak sebagai bagian dari agenda pembangunan berkelanjutan atau SDGs.

title: Let’s Wash Our Hands with HELLO KITTY!! (Hindi Version)
description:
Hello Kitty, a world-renowned character, known for her adorable looks and kindness for others, is all set to familiarize children with the importance of handwashing to promote Achhi Aadat (good habits) among children. Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) and Japanese entertainment company Sanrio (Sanrio Company, Ltd.) have jointly produced a video in Hindi where Hello Kitty sings a song to promote the correct way of handwashing.

The video is as part of its ongoing “Achhi Aadat” (Good Habit) Campaign launched early this year in India to raise awareness about the importance of hygiene practices for preventing the spread of COVID-19 and other infectious diseases.

#HELLOKITTYCHANNEL #JICA #Japan #India #Support #Cause #WASH #AchhiAadatCampaign #COVID19 #pandemic #handwashing #hygiene

description:

title: Let’s Wash Our Hands with HELLO KITTY!! (English Version)
description:
Hello Kitty, a world-renowned character, known for her adorable looks and kindness for others, is all set to familiarize children with the importance of handwashing to promote Achhi Aadat (good habits) among children. Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) and Japanese entertainment company Sanrio (Sanrio Company, Ltd.) have jointly produced a video where Hello Kitty sings a song to promote the correct way of handwashing.

The video is as part of its ongoing “Achhi Aadat” (Good Habit) Campaign launched early this year in India to raise awareness about the importance of hygiene practices for preventing the spread of COVID-19 and other infectious diseases.

title: JICA's Achhi Aadat Campaign
description:
JICA India has launched a campaign, “Achhi Aadat” (Good Habit), in India to raise awareness among people about the importance of hygiene practices for preventing the spread of COVID-19 and other infectious diseases. 

In order to introduce diversified people to easy and practical approach to the hygiene and sanitation, we have created an animated version of the educational manga (cartoon) drawn by a well-known manga artist in Japan, Ms. Kimidori Inoue.  The video is dubbed in Hindi by JICA India staff members and edited by JICA Volunteer (JOCV). Through this video, we hope to promote handwashing in a correct way as well as to raise awareness about the importance of hygiene practices. 

You can download and freely utilize the video and take a part in the Achhi Aadat campaign.

title: JICA's Volunteer Activities in India (2017) - Short Version
description:
JICA's volunteer programs support activities by citizens who wish to cooperate in the economic and social development as well as the reconstruction of developing countries. Through these cooperation activities, participating volunteers can not only contribute to the development of partner countries but also gain valuable experience in terms of international goodwill, mutual understanding and an expansion in their international perspectives.
In India, the program started in 1966 and to this date, over 200 volunteers have been dispatched across India, in the field of Education, Community Development, and Sports, etc.  In this video,  2 volunteers of Japanese Language Education and Community Development talk about their activities and their counterparts respectively share their experience of having a volunteer at their places.

title: Video Conmemorativo de los 30 años de Colaboración de JICA en Nicaragua
description:
El video narra a manera de resumen lo que es JICA y la historia de los 30 años de cooperación en Nicaragua; además, muestra los resultados de algunos de sus proyectos en sectores tales como la educación, salud, agua potable, construcción de puentes, reducción del riesgo de desastres, apoyo a la enseñanza del idioma japonés, entre otros. En cada uno de estos proyectos seleccionados se puede apreciar el impacto que han tenido en los beneficiarios a través de sus propios testimonios.

今年でJICAの対ニカラグア協力が30周年を迎えるにあたって、30年間の協力の歴史とその成果、実際に協力に携わったカウンターパートや関係者の方々の生の声を収録しました。

title: " Olá! Hello!" Narração de estórias em japonês, português e inglês (Miki Nakamura)
description:
“Olá!”
Um gatinho, um cãozinho e um galo vêm até o patinho. Mas o  patinho não entende o que está sendo dito. É um livro ilustrado que mostra a alegria de se comunicar sem as barreiras do idioma.
Este livro foi publicado em 2008, em comemoração ao centenário da imigração japonesa no Brasil.
 
Aproveitem a história em japonês, português ou inglês.
Este vídeo foi criado especialmente para este canal e segue o mesmo formato das sessões de narração de estórias realizadas periodicamente e em formato multilíngue pela biblioteca da JICA Yokohama.
 
_______
"Hello!"
A cat, a dog and a chicken come to  a duck. But the duck doesn't understand what they say. It's a picture book that depicts the joy of being able to communicate as the language barrier disappears.The picture book was published in 2008 to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Japanese immigration to Brazil. The story teller is Ms.Noemia Hinata. Please enjoy in Japanese, Portuguese and English.
 
You can enjoy the multilingual storytelling held regularly at the JICA Yokohama Library in this specially produced video.

title: President's Congratulatory Speech for the 14th International Conference on EASTS in Hiroshima
description:
Transportation is the essential foundation for the development of cities and countries, and it supports people's lives and economic activities. 
Therefore, addressing transportation issues is key to realizing better society and better future.
Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) puts high priority on the transportation sector. Recently, JICA extended its financial and technical support to establish metro and urban railway systems in Asian countries.
Dr. Kitaoka, the president of JICA delivered a congratulatory speech at the opening ceremony on the 14th international conference of Eastern Asia Societies for Transportation Studies (EASTS) on September 12, 2021.

title: Projet Ecole Pour Tous au Madagascar～Déroulement des activités Cantine scolaire d’une école modèle～
description:
L’école primaire publique Ambohimandroso se trouve à environ 2 heures de route au nord-est de la capitale Antananarivo. La mise en place de l’Alimentation scolaire endogène a pour but d’améliorer la qualité de l’éducation des enfants à travers la mobilisation et l’initiative de la communauté qui rassemble tous les acteurs au sein de l’école.

Le comité de gestion de l’école 'FEFFI' (composé des corps enseignants, de parents d’élèves et de la communauté) a planifié des activités sur l’alimentation scolaire qui sont réalistes et réalisables par tout le monde. Ils collectent les ressources ensemble et cuisinent ensemble.

title: Handwash actvities with PPAP2020 in Zambia
description: This video is a 15 minutes-documentary which records handwashing activities organized by JICA Zambia office. PPAP2020, a handwashing song by Japanese comedian Pikotaro, released in April 2020, has been used to encourage the children to wash their hands in a proper and fun way in Lusaka, Zambia. With the cooperation of local NGO and two famous Zambian comedians, JICA sensitized children how to wash their hands properly by performing PPAP2020 with them at assembly halls in two unplanned settlements (compounds) in Lusaka. About 50 children participated in each 30-minute session, and held about 120 sessions in total in the two compounds from October 2020 to February 2021. More than 6,000 children have participated in the activities.

title: Leader Development Program for a Sustainable Future: SDGs Global Leader for the Pacific
description:
The Pacific Island countries (PICs) share much in common in terms of how they organize their societies and their customs with Japan. It is said that “people to people exchange” between PICs and Japan has brought these commonalities dating back long ago. Even now, the Government of PICs and Japan acknowledge the importance of “people to people exchange” in occasions such as the international conference, Pacific Island Leaders Meeting (PALM).

JICA promotes this exchange implementing for young professionals to receive a degree at universities in Japan to become future leaders and achieve SDGs in PICs.

title: NON FORMAL EDUCATION -A Journey of Hope-
description:
In Pakistan, around 22.8 million children are out of school and 60 million young people and adults cannot read or write. These adults and children are unable to get admission in formal schools owing to the age and other circumstances such as social and economic conditions, ethnic and religious differences, and cultural and language barriers. Therefore, they needed alternative and accelerated education system.
JICA's Advancing Quality Alternative Learning Project (AQAL) has provided learning opportunities to out-of-school children, young people and adults through providing Accelerated Learning Program (ALP). In this video you will see how AQAL-ALP attract and motivate not only female and male learners but also parents, community members, and teachers.

title: Trust building is Peace building – a case of social cohesion in Cote d’Ivoire -
description:
【English】
In Greater Abidjan of Côte d'Ivoire, the conflict of the 2000s led to the destruction of infrastructure and the emergence of political divisions and deteriorating relations between residents.
The technical cooperation project "Project for Community Reinforcement Towards Social Cohesion in Greater Abidjan Phase 2(COSAY2)" is targeting communes that were severely affected by the political crisis, with the aim of establishing methods of public service provision that take into account social integration.

【Français】
Dans le Grand Abidjan de Côte d'Ivoire, le conflit des années 2000 a entraîné la destruction d'infrastructures, l'émergence de clivages politiques et la détérioration des relations entre les habitants.
Le projet de coopération technique "Le Projet de Renforcement des Communes pour la Promotion de la Cohésion Sociale dans le Grand Abidjan Phase 2(COSAY2)" cible les communes qui ont été sévèrement touchées par la crise politique, dans le but d'établir des méthodes de provision de services publics qui tiennent compte de l'intégration sociale.

title: WEAVE YOUR DREAMS
description:
This is a documentary video introducing the success stories of female graduates from three garment related vocational training institutes in Faisalabad and Lahore in Pakistan. It is introduced that female trainees are active in employment, development in career, home-based worker and entrepreneurship after obtaining skills at the training institutes. In addition, the training institutes, families of the females, religious leader, government (Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Textile Division), company and associations deliver positive and hearty messages to encourage women and community to advance female participation in the garment industry as they are convinced that women's participation will contribute to the industrial development. This documentary video will be used as an educational material for female trainee recruitment and employment promotion including home-based worker and entrepreneurship support activities and campaigns at the training institutes. It is expected to raise awareness to transform the mindset of women and community for female technical training and work through the female successful cases and positive messages of the documentary video.
パキスタン国ファイサラバード市、ラホール市の服飾職業訓練校3校の女性卒業生の成功事例紹介のドキュメンタリービデオ。女性訓練生が訓練校で技術を習得後、縫製工場への就職、昇進、家内労働、起業を通じて活躍している姿が紹介されている。更に、各職業訓練校、女性の家族、宗教リーダー、政府（商業省繊維局）、企業、組合が、繊維産業での女性参画が業界全体の発展に寄与するとして、それを後押しするポジティブで力強いメッセージが発せられている。このドキュメンタリービデオは、職業訓練校の女性訓練生募集や就労支援の活動・キャンペーンの啓発教材として活用される。このビデオの事例やメッセージが、女性の職業訓練や就労に対する、現地の女性、その家族、コミュニティのマインドセット変革に繋がることが期待される。

title: Emergency Support for Flood Disaster
description: Severe Tropical Cyclone Seroja hit Timor-Leste in April, 2021. The capital Dili was flooded heavily and more than 27000 families were devastated by it. JICA provided emergency relief goods upon the request from Government of the Republic of Timor-Leste. Some of NGO organizations engaging in JICA Japan Partnership Program and Timorese Alumni Association (TJAA) contributed on distribution of relief goods to affected families.

title: Promotion Video for JICA's "Core Human Resource Development for Road Asset Management Program
description: The Core Human Resource Development for Road Asset Management Program is JICA long-term participants project implemented as part of the RAMP(Road Asset Management Platform) project. One purpose of this project is to deepen understanding of technologies related to road asset management among long term  participants in various countries by providing them with opportunities to acquire knowledge and skills related to these technologies at graduate schools in Japan, and get a first person look at the status of efforts in Japan and the field of human resource development. Another purpose is to contribute to development of human resources who will one day play central roles in road asset management in their home countries by building personal connections with government officials and experts in R&D experts in Japan.

title: JICA President KITAOKA's Video Message for "The India-Japan Forum"
description:
JICA President KITAOKA delivered a message at the India-Japan Forum organized by the Ministry of External Affairs of the government of India and the Ananta Aspen Center on July 20, 2021.
  In his video message, welcoming the inauguration of a new Japan-India Track-2 dialogue channel, Dr. Kitaoka emphasized the growth of India was essential for the stability and prosperity of the Indo-Pacific region from various point of views including regional security such as "Free and Open Indo-Pacific".  Also he stated about importance of India-Japan development cooperation to achieve "Human security" through the support for the poor and the vulnerable, support for strengthening of the health sector and support for safe water access and hygiene improvement, in order for India to build back better from COVID-19 calamity.  Other issues, such as promotion of Quality Infrastructure and importance of human resource development including exchange of personnel, were addressed as well.

Note: The India-Japan Forum was established as the platform for Track-2 dialogue and the participants are government officials, academia and business executives of both countries.

title: Reunión de Información y Promoción del Programa “Cátedra JICA” (22 de abril de 2021) en México
description:
El 22 de abril de 2021, se celebró la presente reunión informativa en línea sobre el programa “Cátedra JICA” dirigida a las universidades públicas y privadas de México. Este evento fue organizado por la Agencia de Cooperación Internacional de Japón (JICA) y la Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores de México.
 
La “Cátedra JICA” es un programa que apoya los estudios sobre Japón en universidades extranjeras.
Japón se ha construido, como una nación, libre, y democrática, pacífica, y próspera, y cimentada en el respeto a la ley, sin perder tradiciones e identidades, así como ha conseguido un alto crecimiento económico a través de una política industrial efectiva y la innovación tecnológica. Con base en nuestra historia reciente, Japón ha acumulado una vasta experiencia en materia de cooperación internacional para el desarrollo. Ejemplo de ello, es la ejecución de la Asistencia Oficial para el Desarrollo en beneficio de países asiáticos que han logrado un notable desarrollo socioeconómico y social en los últimos años. Además, Japón contribuye activamente al desarrollo sostenible en el mundo, encabezando la investigación académica en la materia, así como aprovechando la experiencia y lecciones aprendidas tanto en nuestro propio proceso de modernización como en la larga práctica de cooperación para el desarrollo desplegada en el exterior.

Precisamente, la “Cátedra JICA” es un proyecto fundado con el propósito de brindar oportunidades para que los futuros líderes de cada país, desde las principales universidades del mundo, conozcan la experiencia histórica de Japón y su proceso de modernización a fin de poder aplicar, en el desarrollo de su país, muchas de las lecciones que ofrece el modelo japonés.

title: Project Activities
description:
Introduction of JICA Technical Cooperation project " the Project for Strengthening the Water Service Management of Pyanj and Khamadoni Vodokanals", which implemented "Handwashing for health and life campaign” in Tajikistan.
This project started in April 2017 and is scheduled to end in June 2021.
In response to the widespread COVID-19, we are practicing to deliver safe water to citizens as tap water, including providing chlorine for disinfection of water supply, which has become difficult to procure.

title: Hand Washing Campaign
description:
“Handwashing for health and life campaign” was held as part of the JICA Technical Cooperation project "the Project for Strengthening the Water Service Management of Pyanj and Khamadoni Vodokanals" in Tajikistan. We held a handwashing campaign for for about 1,700 elementary school students from four schools in Pyanj for four days from March 16th to 19th, 2021.
Each child received a pamphlet illustrating the proper way to wash hands, translated into Tajik, and a bar of soap.
We distributed 2,000 bars of soap, including students from the nursing school who taught handwashing and prefectural officials who participated in the campaign.
This video was aired as news in Tajikistan and neighboring countries.

title: BOSAI and Beyond:Building Disaster Resilient Cities -Online Seminar Co-Sponsored with the Inter-ADB-
description: Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) is a disaster-prone region, experiencing numerous earthquakes, floods, landslies, hurricanes, and other natural disasters, similar to Japan. According to the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) the region experienced 4,125 natural disasters between 1980 and 2016, whose economic loss amount to approximately US$282 billion. The LAC region also has a high urbanization rate (over 80% of its population lives in urban areas), and therefore, buildting and maintaining disaster-resilient cities is fundamental to sustainable socio-economic development. In this online-seminar, JICA share experiences in building disaster-resilient cities in Asia, and the City of Sendai shared their experience in rebuilding from the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake. Presenters from Chile and Colombia were invited by the IDB to share their experiences and knowledge on building tsunami-resilient and earthquake resilient cities.

title: Senegal: 40ans de présence permanente du JOCV au Sénégal
description:
En perspective des 60 ans de relations diplomatiques entre le Japon et le Sénégal,il est important de mettre en exergue les 40 années de coopération acquis entre le Japon et le Sénégal à travers le volontariat. En 1980,le gouvernement japonais avait décidé d'envoyer auprès du gouvernement du Sénégal trois (03) jeunes volontaires et ceci après l'accord d'envoi des volontaires signé entre les deux pays en 1979. Depuis lors plus de 1000 volontaires ont servi au Sénégal et font montre d'une excellente coopération avec des compétences avérées dans les domaines de l'éducation, la santé, le développement communautaire, l'agriculture, l'élevage, la formation professionnelle, la pêche, le sport et la protection sociale.Aujourd'hui, nous comptons neuf (09) régions réceptrices et sept (07) secteurs d’activités. 
Les activités des volontaires dans ces domaines ont permis d'améliorer les conditions de vie des populations à travers la production et de la valorisation des ressources agricoles, animales et halieutiques.
 Le Japon, malgré un espace géographique exploitable très limité a atteint aujourd'hui un niveau de développement important. Cela est possible grâce à la motivation, le culte du travail et la loyauté de son peuple. 
Pour tout dire, les nouvelles bases de l’avenir de la coopération à travers la JOCV a comme crédo, travailler et vivre ensemble pour un développement efficient du capital humain.

title: International Day of the Girl Child: Messages from Sakura Girls Secondary School in Tanzania
description:
In Tanzania, especially in its rural area, it is still very common for schoolgirls to end their education at the primary level, based on the traditional values that “education is not necessary for girls”. In addition, parents decide their marriage in their early teens, and the girls get pregnant and give childbirth soon after, which becomes one of the causes of expansion of poverty with its population growth.

Even in such a society, the girls who can get an opportunity to learn are now having hope for the future and shining toward their dreams, even though their opportunities once have been deprived.

Sakura Girls Secondary School is a boarding school established by Group Kilimanjaro Inc. in 2016. The school educates the next generation’s leaders by providing "student-centered learning", which encourages students to think and act by themselves and develops their independence of mind.

JICA is supporting the operation of Sakura Girls Secondary School through JICA Partnership Program as a model school to provide opportunities for secondary school girls nationwide.

We received messages from the girls who realized that “they don’t have to give up” through all the support for them to have opportunities, hope, and possibilities. They also want to tell their messages to all the women working in the world!

title: JICA Cooperation in Palau：パラオにおけるJICAの取り組み
description:
The relationship between Palau and Japan is historically strong, and nowadays the two nations have enjoyed close economic relationship through tourism utilising the abundant natural environment in Palau.
However, environmental issues such as management of increasing waste, conservation of the living resources, and countermeasures against climate change are still to be resorved. Moreover, Palau faces developmental difficulties like other small island countries in the Pacific Resion; delay in infrastructure development like energy and water supply, lack of transportation network, limited educational and medical opportunities and insufficient industrial development. 
JICA has been cooperating with Palau for more than 20 years to deal with these issues utilizing technical cooperation, volunteers, grant aid, etc.  In this video,  JICA's latest coopeartions are presented.


日本との歴史的な関わりが深く、また今はその美しい海、珊瑚礁にを楽しみに多くの日本人が訪れているパラオ。一方で、廃棄物対策、生物資源保全や気候変動対応といった環境分野、そしてエネルギー、水供給、交通網、教育や保健、産業振興などの各分野で、小さな島国故に抱えている問題も数多い。このためJICAが国際協力をパラオで展開してきて20年以上が経つ。技術協力、ボランティア、無償資金協力など多岐に渡る取り組みを、特に近年のものにスポットを当てて紹介する。

title: JICA et ville de Yokohama – vers le futur ensemble avec l’Afrique
description: Lorsque le port a été ouvert en 1859, Yokohama n’était qu’un village de pêcheurs d’à peine une centaine de foyers. Aujourd’hui, c’est une ville internationale où vivent 3,7 millions de personnes. Précisément parce qu’elle a connu un développement spectaculaire, Yokohama dispose d’un savoir-faire qu’elle peut partager avec les villes africaines qui sont en train de se développer rapidement. Cette vidéo présente les activités de coopération au développement en Afrique réalisé par la JICA et la ville de Yokohama.

title: JICA and the City of Yokohama Into the Future with Africa
description:
Yokohama was a fishing village with only 100 households when it opened in 1859. Today, it is an international city where 3.7 million people live. Yokohama has undergone remarkable development, so we have the know-how to share with the rapidly growing cities of Africa.
We would like to introduce an example of efforts for international cooperation between JICA and the City of Yokohama in Africa.

As part of project activities, the project is doing awareness raising activities on importance of women employment targeting communities in Karachi, in which the project uses this video to 1) deliver concrete images of working successful women to motivate and inspire young women, and 2) make male family  members realize a variety and possibilities of careers of women.

Hartha Thermal Power Plant, the crutial power plant in Basrah Governorate of Southern Iraq, was established in 1982 with the aid from Japan. Subsequently, in order for rehabilitation and upgrade, JICA has extended loan twice for the plant;  the phase 1 project for rehabilitation of Unit 4, and the phase 2 for refurbishment work of Unit 1 in order for the plant to restore the original output rate of 200MW respectively. 

This is a story how the improvement of electricity supply helped local industry.

Iraq Project Series: Electricity Sector Reconstruction Project in Kurdistan Region (Human Element)
description:
In Iraq, including the Kurdistan Region, has long suffered from the shortage of power supply due to the lack of new investments or management and maintenance of existing facilities. In order to tackle the shortage of electricity infrastructure, the project recovered the electricity network in various locations in the Kurdistan Region through the provision of necessary equipment, rehabilitation of transmission and distributing systems and so forth. The project was successfully completed in 2018.

Let's hear the story of Osta Herish, a local carpenter, talks about how the improved electricity supply helped his business.

This Project improved water supply services in the target cities, by constructing water treatment, transmission and distribution facilities.

title: Histoire du développement agricole au Japon «5. Amélioration de la nutrition»
description: En tant qu'agence de mise en œuvre de l'APD (Aide Publique au Développement) au Japon, la JICA (l’Agence Japonaise de Coopération Internationale) a coopéré avec plusieurs pays en développement et possède une longue histoire de coopération, en particulier dans le domaine de l'agriculture, y compris dans le développement des ressources humaines. Cette expérience peut être utilisée comme référence pour le développement agricole dans les pays en développement, c'est pourquoi la JICA a réalisé 5 courtes vidéos intitulées 1. Histoire de l'agriculture japonaise, 2. Développement de la riziculture, 3. Vulgarisation et conseil agricoles, 4. Amélioration des terres agricoles et 5. Amélioration de la nutrition, afin d'introduire systématiquement "L'évolution du développement agricole au Japon". Cette vidéo est l'une d'entre elles, "5. Amélioration de la nutrition". Nous avons également réalisé et publié des versions japonaise et anglaise, il serait donc très apprécié qu'elles puissent être largement utilisées comme outil de développement des ressources humaines dans l'agriculture et que de nombreuses personnes intéressées par l'agriculture japonaise peut regarder cette vidéo.

title: Histoire du développement agricole au Japon «4. Amélioration des terres agricoles»
description: En tant qu'agence de mise en œuvre de l'APD (Aide Publique au Développement) au Japon, la JICA (l’Agence Japonaise de Coopération Internationale) a coopéré avec plusieurs pays en développement et possède une longue histoire de coopération, en particulier dans le domaine de l'agriculture, y compris dans le développement des ressources humaines. Cette expérience peut être utilisée comme référence pour le développement agricole dans les pays en développement, c'est pourquoi la JICA a réalisé 5 courtes vidéos intitulées 1. Histoire de l'agriculture japonaise, 2. Développement de la riziculture, 3. Vulgarisation et conseil agricoles, 4. Amélioration des terres agricoles et 5. Amélioration de la nutrition, afin d'introduire systématiquement "L'évolution du développement agricole au Japon". Cette vidéo est l'une d'entre elles, "4. Amélioration des terres agricoles". Nous avons également réalisé et publié des versions japonaise et anglaise, il serait donc très apprécié qu'elles puissent être largement utilisées comme outil de développement des ressources humaines dans l'agriculture et que de nombreuses personnes intéressées par l'agriculture japonaise peut regarder cette vidéo.

title: The Evolution of Agricultural Development in Japan“5. Nutrition Improvement”
description: As Japan's ODA (Official Development Assistance) implementing agency, JICA (Japan International Cooperation Agency) has been providing various cooperation to developing countries, and has a long history of cooperation especially in the field of agriculture, including human resource development. JICA believes that Japan's experience can be used as a reference for agricultural development in developing countries, therefore JICA made 5 short videos which titled 1. History of Japanese Agriculture, 2. Development of Rice Farming, 3. Agricultural Extension and Support, 4. Land Improvement and 5. Nutrition Improvement, in order to systematically introduce “The Evolution of Agricultural Development in Japan".  This video is one of them,“5. Nutrition Improvement”. We have also made and released Japanese and French versions, so it would be greatly appreciated that thay can be widely used as a tool for human resources development in agriculture and that many people who are interested in Japanese agriculture can watch this video.

title: Grand Egyptian Museum Joint Conservation Project (20 minutes version)
description:
Close to the historical pyramids in Giza area lies the construction site of the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM). The Museum is constructed with the financial and technical support by Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), and the planned opening is approaching in the fall of 2020!



Along with the museum construction, JICA has also been working with the Conservation Center situated next to GEM over the past decade. The joint activities include the conservation work of the most beautiful artifacts of King Tutankhamun! See the video for details of the "Grand Egyptian Museum Joint Conservation Project (GEM-JC)".

title: Initiative pour la sécurité alimentaire et nutritionnelle en Afrique (IFNA)
description:
En 2016, à l'occasion de la TICAD VI, la JICA et AUDA-NEPAD (Agence de développement de l'Union africaine - Nouveau partenariat pour le développement de l'Afrique) ont lancé l'Initiative pour la sécurité alimentaire et nutritionnelle en Afrique, communément appelée IFNA.　Lors de la TICAD7 de 2019, la "Déclaration de l'IFNA - Yokohama 2019" a été établie pour contribuer à l'amélioration de la nutrition de 200 millions d'enfants en Afrique.

Cette vidéo présente la vue d'ensemble de l'IFNA, des exemples d'activités locales et les perspectives d'avenir.

title: JICA Volunteer Program in Philippines - Agriculture
description: With our planet’s daily reminders of climate change and diminishing natural resources, a group of young Japanese volunteers are helping Filipino farmers with thoughtful solutions on how to make their livelihood more sustainable. See how Tadahiro Ikoma, Ayano Yushimura, Koki Itagaki, and Asuka Kunisawa are sharing Japan's experience on sustainable agriculture with local communities.

title: JICA Volunteer Program in Philippines- Disaster Risk Reduction & Management (DRRM)
description: Japan is a country known for its disaster risk reduction expertise. They draw from their own experiences dealing with natural disasters and the rich, high-tech technology they developed. But, they are also aware that the people’s own disaster preparedness can help minimize damage. See how young Japanese volunteers Natsuko Kitamura, Kazuyoshi Naito, and Naoaki Tsunoda are helping communities in the Philippines prepare for disasters.

title: JICA Volunteer Program in Philippines- Manufacturing
description: They say an act of compassion can grow into something wonderful. See how young Japanese designers Yuka Ishihara, Midori Morita, and Minato Shiina are doing just that to help students, small enterprises, and women entrepreneurs in designing products for income.

title: For a Brighter Future: Africa's Aims　(Part2)
description:
The Japanese government has been leading TICAD (Tokyo International Conference on African Development) since 1993, and this year, the seventh TICAD conference was held from August 28 to 30 in Yokohama, Japan. This program features a panel discussion entitled "Global Governance in Africa and Japan" hosted by JICA as a side event to the TICAD7. 
Up to now, the international community has largely been based on multilateralism and liberalism. However, in recent years, unilateralism and protectionism have made the world significantly more unstable. Africa has achieved remarkable growth in the 21st century. Moving forward, what role should it play in the international community? In addition, what role should Japan play in supporting Africa's development?

【Part1】 
With a population of 1.3 billion, Africa is being called the “last new major market” as it tries to attract private investment from around the world. Part 1 of this program discusses how Africa can increase private investment. And, how to view the relationship between China and Africa, given China’s active investment in Africa.

【Part 2】
What is crucial to Africa’s growth is how to get its 420 million young people to actively participate in the economy. Part 2 of this program discusses what Africa and the rest of the world can do to get youth to participate. And, what Africa should do to achieve the democratic governance that the international community is seeking.

[Panelists]
・Soraya M. Hakuziyaremye, Minister of Trade and Industry of Rwanda (Part2 only)
・Amadou Ba, Minister of Foreign Affairs of Senegal (Part1 only)
・Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, Board Chair, Gavi The Vaccine Alliance
・Joseph Stiglitz, professor of Columbia University
・Shinichi Kitaoka, President of JICA
[Moderator]
・Aiko Doden, Special Affairs Commentator, World News Division, NHK　WORLD TV, NHK (Japan Broadcasting Corporation)

title: For our life and future: Refugee Camp Improvement Project in Palestine
description: Due to decreasing aid and deteriorating infrastructure, living conditions in Palestinean refugee camps are getting more and more severe and harsh. JICA and PLO-DORA has started “Refugee Camp Improvement Project” (PALCIP) in 3 camps in the West Bank. Each camp organizes a forum where representatives of various categories in the camp (women, youth, seniors and disabled among others) could discuss the problems and the future of the camp and make a concrete Camp Improvement Plan, including vision, strategy and priority actions. PALCIP also organized a mechanism of inducting internal/external funding to realize the Plan by enforcing camp improvement projects based on the needs of the camp. PALCIP provides camp residents an opportunity to engage proactively in improving their life in the camp. In this video, PLO-DORA staff and camp residents reveal the big leap introduced by the Project, and their commitments and hope for the future.

title: [Sissala language]What can you do to ensure all pregnant women deliver safely? Part2
description:
This community drama was developed to promote the usage of antenatal care, skilled delivery and post-natal care services in the Upper West Region of Ghana, with the intended usage to be aired at the local health centers and within the communities. The drama was performed and developed by the people of Upper West Region with the support from Ghana Health Service (GHS). The video was produced by GHS/JICA Project for Improvement of  Maternal and Neonatal Health Services Utilising CHPS System in the Upper West Region. It is performed in Sissala language with English subtitles.

JICAガーナ共和国「アッパーウエスト州地域保健機能を活用した妊産婦・新生児保健サービス改善プロジェクト」では、産前・産後健診、熟練医療従事者の介助による分娩の増加を目指し、啓発用ドラマを製作しました。このドラマの出演者は、アッパーウエスト州のコミュニティの住民で、コミュニティで使われている現地語（英字幕）で演じられています。

description: Le programme de coopération tripartite a débuté en 1998, suite aux recommandations du plan d’action adopté lors de la deuxième Conférence Internationale de Tokyo sur le Développent de l’Afrique (TICADⅡ). Son objectif est de transférer le savoir-faire acquis par les institutions marocaines dans plusieurs domaines a d’autres pays africains.

title: Contribution de la coopération japonaise dans le secteur de la santé au Maroc
description: Depuis 2002, le secteur de la santé, en particulier celui de la mère et de l’enfant, est l’un des axes prioritaires de la coopération japonaise au Maroc. Cette coopération se décline sous la forme d’un soutien technique et financier, de l’envoi d’experts et volontaires japonais ainsi que des stages de formation au Japon.

title: Projets de la JICA Maroc dans le programme de Partenariat Public-Prive(PPP)
description: En apportant son soutien a l’introduction des technologies et produits de pointe des entreprises privées japonaises, la JICA contribue à la résolution des problèmes socio-économiques auxquels est confronté le Maroc.

title: Contribution de la coopération japonaise dans le secteur de l’éducation au Maroc
description: La JICA soutient, depuis 2003, le développement du secteur de l’éducation au Maroc à travers des projets de coopération financière, technique et les activités des volontaires. L’objectif est d’accompagner le pays dans le processus d’amélioration de accès et de la qualité de l’éducation de base dans les milieux rural et urbain.

title: Contribution de la coopération japonaise dans le secteur de l’agriculture au Maroc
description: A travers son appui budgétaire et technique au secteur agricole marocain, la JICA contribue au renforcement de la compétitivité du secteur pour une croissance économique inclusive et verte.

title: Mathématique et Petite Enfance: Un film Documentaire sur les Activités de Volontaires Japonais
description:
La JICA depuis quelques années accorde une importance cruciale au développement de la petite enfance. C’est dans cette optique que les interventions des volontaires du préscolaire et élémentaire que relatent cette vidéo gravitent autour des activités ludiques comme moyen d’éveil et de développement des sens. Selon Mme Naomi KOIZUMI volontaire senior affectée à la Direction de L’Education préscolaire du Ministère de l’Education Nationale intervenant ici à l’école maternelle publique de la Gueule Tapée Médina à Dakar, l’autonomie et la liberté dans l’apprentissage permettent aux enfants de découvrir d’eux-mêmes le pouvoir des nombres, le pouvoir des mots, la science, l’art et la sociabilité.  

SATO Nobuko et FUJIMOTO Minoru, les deux volontaires juniors de cette vidéo travaillent à l’Inspection d’Education et de la formation de Thiès On les montre dans des séquences où ils suscitent l’éveil mathématique chez les élèves en créant un environnement propice d’expérimentation directe, de familiarisation pratique avec des objets et des phénomènes faisant partie de leur environnement quotidien. Ils arrivent ainsi à promouvoir le raisonnement et la créativité chez les enfants.

title: Senegal: Santé Maternelle et Infantile: Un film sur la Nutrition et Développement Communautaire
description:
Ce film documentaire montre les activités de 03 volontaires japonais travaillant dans le domaine de la santé sur le thème : santé maternelle et infantile, nutrition et développement communautaire. Il s’agit de mesdemoiselles TAKAKHASHI Miki et NODOMI Ayumi respectivement agent de développement communautaire et sage-femme de métier.

Leur intervention au District Sanitaire de Diofior dans la région de Fatick est généralement axée sur des activités dans les postes et cases de santé avec des visites à domicile et causeries en compagnie de relais communautaire. Cette bonne collaboration est très bien perçue par les bénéficiaires qui voient dans ces volontaires des personnes dévouées et infatigables. 
Dans la région de Tambacounda au Sud du Sénégal et à 467 km de Dakar Mlle SAKUMA Yui appelée Seynabou au Sénégal joue son rôle de volontaire à travers les consultations prénatales et la promotion sur l’usage du carnet de santé maternelle. Même si elle pense apporter une modeste contribution, l’histoire retiendra que la coopération sénégalo japonaise à travers la modalité du JOCV est une coopération gagnant gagnant,  c’est-à-dire un échange d’expérience mutuellement bénéfique.

title: Celebrating 10th Anniversary ― JICA Alumni Association of Kosovo
description: The year 2019 marks the 10th anniversary of JICA Alumni Association of Kosovo (JAAK). Up to March 2019, over 360 Kosovars have gone to Japan for training programs and the returnees are actively using knowledge and experiences gained from Japan. This movie shows the real voice of the returnees and the activities of JAAK.

Welcome to As-Salt!

title: Ethiopia: CREATIVITY in MOTION
description:
Ethiopia is the cradle of many unique and high quality products. JICA is supporting the promotion of 'MADE IN ETHIOPIA' products.
To deliver the story of fascinating creations of Ethiopia towards the world, JICA has produced a promotional video of these products.

The Cradle of Mankind. Ethiopia.
It is the land where mankind first started creation.
 
In producing new inventions like coffee one after another,

and created a new culture to people around the world.

A new challenge of Africa’s largest growing nation begins. 
 
Creativity in Motion.
ETHIOPIA

The total length of the tunel is 2.69 kms and its estimated completion date of the project is August 2022.

title: The Bridges of the World with Care -Supporting Economy and Security-
description:
Bridges are fundamental infrastructure connecting areas divided by river, valley and sea to ensure smooth and safe transportation. Bridges significantly contribute to generating economic development in their surrounding region, and facilitating the cross-border trade. We can say that bridges play such an important role to connect people and people, city and city, and country and country.
　On the other hand, many bridges in developing countries have not been well maintained since constructed in colonial days. Deterioration of bridges has been one of the serious problem and disturb economic growth in those countries.
　To tackle those situations, "Bridge Maintenance Training" has been started in year 2015. Through this training course, about 20 civil engineers of bridges are invited to Nagasaki University from developing countries every year.  They learn practical knowledge about how to conduct inspections, diagnostics and record the result as well as repairing methods. This is the program for human resource development in cooperation with industry, government, academic and the local community.
  Not only providing training in Japan, onsite monitoring is one of main components of this program.  All the participants are required to form action plans to be implemented in their country at the end of the training since practical capacities can be gained through experiences. After 6 months from the training, trainers visit two or three countries to see their progress of the action plans.  And monitoring team assist and follow-up their activities by technical advice, holding seminar and onsite workshop. The results of the monitoring is reflected on training contents for next year. This training course contribute to achieve SDGs goal 9 (industrial innovation and infrastructure) and goal 11 (sustainable cities and communities) as well.

Yokohama’s remarkable development has given the city experience and know-how to share with cities in Africa, which are currently experiencing rapid growth.
This video is to introduce activities of development cooperation for cities in Africa by JICA and the City of Yokohama.

title: A mosaic protection shelter at the world’s oldest city
description:
Jericho in Palestine is said to be one of the world’s oldest cities, and is home to the site of Hisham’s Palace, a cultural property representative of early Islamic architecture from the Umayyad dynasty (eighth century). It is home to one of the largest single bathhouse mosaic floors in the Middle East, at approximately 825 square meters in size, which remains in good condition. Soon after it was constructed, Hisham’s Palace was destroyed in an earthquake. Because the mosaic floor had been covered in sand until it was excavated in the middle of the 20th century, it remains in pristine condition even now. The excavated floor was found to be exquisitely crafted and extremely well preserved – the best of its kind in the Middle East. Of particular note is the mosaic known as the “Tree of Life,” which graces the floor of the bathhouse audience chamber. An amazing sense of movement is expressed in the lion and deer motif represented there, forming such a wonderful sight that visitors are transfixed by the workmanship.

In order to preserve this precious relic for future generations, JICA is lending its support in the construction of a dome-shaped shelter to protect the bathhouse and floor mosaic, as well as a sightseeing trail inside to make this rare floor mosaic available as a tourism resource. These efforts are expected to both protect and enable use of this historically valuable cultural property and to significantly contribute to attracting tourists to Palestine and stimulate regional tourism.

Currently the floor mosaic is not visible in the palace as construction of the dome-shaped shelter and sightseeing trail is underway with the goal of completion at the end of 2019. In an effort to educate others about the wonder of this valuable floor mosaic, which is an important cultural property to Palestine , the interior of the completed shelter based on conceptual drawings can be viewed from various angles. A CG rendering provides close-up and bird’s-eye views of the mosaic which are normally not available to visitors. 

Please take the chance to visit Palestine to see the actual mosaic in person after construction is complete.

description:
In #Malawi, Japan Overseas Cooperation Volunteers (#JOCVs) faced difficulties to teach mathematic in primary schools because even final grade students found it hard to master the multiplication table. 
JOCVs have released “the multiplication song” in collaboration with students from Liongwe Teachers Training College. The song has a good beat and students get too excited while learning! Please read JOCV’s report in Malawi and listen to the song!

title: Le projet de Schéma Directeur d'Aménagement et d'Urbanisme de Nouakchott (Mauritanie)
description: En 2016, la JICA a soutenu les études de l'élaboration du Schéma Directeur d'Aménagement d'Urbanisme (SDAU) horizon 2040 de la ville de Nouakchott en Mauritanie. Par ailleurs, des mesures d'accompagnement ainsi qu'un guide technique visant à faciliter la mise en œuvre du SDAU, ont aussi été formulées dans le cadre du projet. Ces documents vont aider à la réalisation d'un aménagement durable des infrastructures urbaines de Nouakchott, visant l'efficacité économique mais aussi le respect des considérations sociales et environnementales.

title: Envisioning the Future of Mauritania -Nouakchott City Urban Master Plan Development Project
description: Since 2016, JICA has supported the formulation of a Development Masterplan on urban planning targeting 2040 for the City of Nouakchott in Mauritania. Along with the Masterplan, the project also formulated related policies, systems and guidelines that would facilitate the implementation of the Masterplan. Using the finalized Masterplan, it is expected that sustainable development will be realized in the development of the urban infrastructure of Nouakchott with thorough considerations towards social and economic efficiency and environment protection.

title: Recovery moved forward
description: More than 3,000 messages of support for the affected areas were sent to JICA from more than 100 countries. Recovery moved forward in the affected areas through the cooperation of many people and many countries. Now, this experience is being put to work to other disaster-affected areas of the world. Japan and other countries share their mutual experiences and aim for cooperation that helps both places recover.

title: Education a La Diversite a Travers Le Cecifoot - Education To Diversity Through Blind Soccer -
description:
Afin de promouvoir l'éducation à la diversité, la JICA en collaboration avec le Ministère de l'Education Nationale (MEN) et la Fédération japonaise de Cécifoot a organisé le jeudi 10 mai 2018 une journée d'activités physiques, pédagogiques, et ludiques au CFPT Sénégal - Japon. Cette journée qui rentrait dans le cadre de la célébration de la Semaine Nationale de l'Education de Base a permis de regrouper une centaine d'enfants de différentes écoles de football de Dakar. Les volontaires de la JICA ont encadré les enfants à travers des activités ludiques pour développer leurs compétences en communication, leur esprit d'équipe, leur compréhension de l'handicap, et leur engagement social. La vidéo montre le rôle du sport dans le renforcement de la cohésion sociale et le vivre ensemble. Un match de Cecifoot opposant les volontaires aux étudiants de l'INEFJA (Institut National d'Education et de Formation des Jeunes Aveugles) a été organisé en prélude de la rencontre de coupe du monde de football entre le Sénégal et le Japon.  

In order to promote the education of diversity, JICA in collaboration with the Ministery of National Education and the Japan Blind Football Association (JBFA) organized on thursday, may 10th ,2018 a  physical, educational, and playful day at the Technical and Professional  Training Center Senegal-Japan. This journey which was  part of the National Basic Education Week brought together  hundred children from various  football academies located in Dakar. JOCV have mentored children through playful activities in order to develop communication skills, teamwork, understanding of disability, and social commitment. This video shows the role of sport in strengthening social cohesion and living together. A blind soccer match between the volunteers and the students of the National Institut for Education and Training of young blind people was organized in prelude to the world cup football match between Senegal and Japan.

title: Strengthening maternal and child health. What does Japan have to teach us?
description:
The TSURU PROJECT carried out by the South Brazilian Alumni Association in Japan (ASBBJ), presents in this video, Júnia Aparecida Laia da Mata, PhD. She is an Obstetric Nurse, a Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) Ex-alumni and Professor of the Maternal and Child Nursing Department of the Nursing School of the Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS). In her  lecture entitled "Strengthening maternal and child health. What does Japan have to teach us?" she tells us a bit about her experience  in Okinawa and another cities in Japan and explains how maternal and child health care in Japan is conducted and how the Japanese population's culture of co-responsibility acts to maintain the welfare of the entire community.

O PROJETO TSURU da Associação Sul Brasileira de Bolsistas no Japão (ASBBJ), apresenta neste video,  Profa. Dra. Júnia Aparecida Laia da Mata. Ela é  Enfermeira Obstetra, ex bolsista da Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) e Professora do  Departamento de Enfermagem Materno-Infantil da Escola de Enfermagem da Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS). Em sua palestra intitulada "Fortalecimento da saúde materno infantil. O que o Japão tem a nos ensinar?" ela conta um pouco sobre sua experiência em Okinawa e em outros locais do Japão e esclarece como a atenção à saúde materna e infantil é conduzida naquele país e como a cultura da co-responsabilização da população japonesa atua em manter o bem-estar de toda a comunidade.

title: Capacity Development Project in Myanmar Power Sector
description: This project is capacity development of power transmission and distribution systems in order to improve efficiency and reliability of power supply and energy access in Myanmar.

title: Grand Egyptian Museum Introductory Movie (5 minutes version）
description:
Close to the historical pyramids in Giza area lies the construction site of the Grand Egyptian Museum. The Museum is constructed with the financial and technical support by Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA). After its opening planned in 2020, the Museum will be exhibiting the precious artifacts produced by the rich Egyptian culture.

JICA has also been supporting the human resource development in the area of conservation and restoration of artifacts in  Egypt from 2008. In 2010, the Government of Egypt established a Conservation Center in the same Giza area as the Museum, which has accelerated the on-going collaboration between Egypt and JICA. Up to today, JICA has continued to provide technical support to improve conservation and analytical techniques of staffs from the Conservation Center. Preparation for the exhibition in the new Museum is also making rapid progress.

title: Blumenau+10: Disaster Prevention in Brazil
description: Blumenau + 10 (10 years from the occurrence of natural disaster) is a special documentary in the memory of the 2008 climatic catastrophe which happened in Santa Catarina state. The video analyzes the evolution of natural disaster prevention in the region. The documentary features images and interviews produced in Japan by journalist Mr. Evandro de Assis, who took a JICA´s course in October 2018. During his course, he was introduced to Sabo technology (debris flow containment dams) among other Japanese experiences that may inspire the theme of disaster prevention in Brazil.                                                                                   * Language is Portuguese

title: Chinches Bandidos
description:
Los "chinches" son los insectos que anidan en las casas rurales de América Latina, chupan sangre de seres humanos y transmiten la Enfermedad de Chagas. Esta canción fue compuesta por un grupo musical de los alumnos de la escuela primaria en Nicaragua, con el apoyo de una voluntaria japonesa, Srita. Mariko Sasahara. Con los ritmos de Corrido y Son Nica, los cantantes chiquitos están enseñando cómo tenemos que prevenir y controlar estos chinches bandidos en nuestra casa. A partir del año 2000, la Agencia de Cooperación Internacional del Japón (JICA) ha apoyado a los países centroamericanos para fortalecer el control y la prevención de esta enfermedad. Para más información, visite nuestra página web:

title: Let's try therapeutic hands!  ～An introduction of Japanese Medical Manual Therapy (JMMT)～
description:
Let's try therapeutic hands! 
～An introduction of Japanese Medical Manual Therapy (JMMT)～

It is estimated that more than 10 million persons with visual impairments live in India. Many of them have neither the opportunity of education and employment nor that of participating in the society. To change this situation, a JICA Partnership Program, the Vocational education support for the visually impaired in India, has been implemented since 2013 in collaboration with the Special Needs Education School for the Visually Impaired, University of Tsukuba. In this project, Japanese experts teach the Japanese Medical Manual Therapy (JMMT) as a vocational skill to persons with visual impairments in the National Association for the Blind, a NGO, in Ahmedabad of the Gujarat state and in the National Institute for the Visually Handicapped in Dehradun of the Uttarakhand state. 

People generally have never heard about JMMT in India. As the introduction of the JMMT, JICA made a movie under the editorial supervision of Mr. Naoshi TERASAKI (from the Special Needs Education School for the Visually Impaired, University of Tsukuba) and Dr. Saburo SASADA. The movie shows what JMMT is and how enormous hidden potentialities JMMT would provide for persons with visual impairments to participate in the society.

title: Field Museum – Project in the Amazon Forest
description: The Field Museum project is located in the Amazon Forest-Brazil. The project aims to enable observation and research of wildlife in locus, thus fostering environmental education practices. In addition, the project develops researches about manatees and enables its reintroduction into the natural habitat. *Audio is in Portuguese and subtitles are in English.

title: Peace promotion through sports: The Third National Unity Day in South Sudan, 2018
description: Over 300 youths from across South Sudan gathered in the capital Juba between 27 January and 4 February 2018, to participate in the nine day-long festivities which were organized under the theme 'Peace and Social Cohesion'. The series of events, called the National Unity Day (NUD), provide an opportunity for the South Sudanese to come together and embrace the diversity and peaceful coexistence. The events included a football tournament, athletic track events, a volleyball tournament as well as awareness and cultural activities for the youth. The youth shared accommodation and dined and trained together, which helped them gain better understanding of the people from other parts of the country. The events attracted hundreds of thousands of crowds, who enjoyed watching sports, cheering the athletes, and being together, in a peaceful environment. The program is organized by the Ministry of Culture, Youth and Sports, South Sudan, in collaboration with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA).  For more information visit: https://www.jica.go.jp/south_sudan/english/office/topics/180320.html

title: [Coopération JICA en éducation] Approche Forum s’appuyant sur la participation communautaire (6/6)]
description:
En utilisant le réseau du Comité de Gestion d’Ecole, est-ce qu’ il n’est pas possible de faire quelque chose pour résoudre les problèmes d’éducation de la région ?
Le Projet « Ecole Pour Tous » a introduit l’Approche Forum vise à améliorer l’environnement scolaire de la région avec différents auteurs impliqués dans le développement de l’éducation, telles que la Fédération des Comités de Gestion d’Ecole, les collectivités locales, et l’administration scolaire.
Le JICA appui des activités de la Comité de Gestion d'Ecole par le projet « Ecole Pour Tous » en Niger, Sénégal, Burkina Faso, Mali, Côte-d'Ivoire et au Madagascar.

title: [Coopération JICA en éducation] Utilisation efficace et transparente des subventions (5/6)]
description:
Malgré de nombreux programmes de subvention aux écoles menés en Afrique, cela ne semble pas avoir d’effet encourageant.
Comment peut-on utiliser des fonds de subvention pour améliorer la qualité des apprentissages ?
La réponse est le «  Modèle pour une  utilisation efficace et transparente du fonds de subvention »  qui fait partie du Projet « Ecole Pour Tous ». 
Le JICA appui des activités de la Comité de Gestion d'Ecole par le projet « Ecole Pour Tous » en Niger, Sénégal, Burkina Faso, Mali, Côte-d'Ivoire et au Madagascar.

title: [Coopération JICA en éducation] Paquet Minimum Axé sur la Qualité des Apprentissages (PMAQ) (4/6)]
description:
La réalisation de l'amélioration du niveau de connaissance a été possible par le“Paquet Minimum Axé sur la Qualité", le modèle d'amélioration du niveau des connaissances de base à travers la participation de la communauté. Ce paquet est composé de 4 éléments : 1)pratique  Le "Test de niveau“ pour mettre au clair le niveau des connaissances des élèves, 2)La promotion de la participation des membres de la communauté à travers le « Partage d’informations avec la communauté » des résultats du test, 3) L’utilisation des "Livrets d’exercices efficaces" pour l’amélioration du niveau des connaissances des élèves, 4) L’assurance du temps des "Activités supplémentaires de remédiation appuyées par la communauté".
Le JICA appui des activités de la Comité de Gestion d'Ecole par le projet « Ecole Pour Tous » en Niger, Sénégal, Burkina Faso, Mali, Côte-d'Ivoire et au Madagascar.

title: [Coopération JICA en éducation] Paquet Minimum pour un Comité de Gestion d'Ecole fonctionnel(3/6)]
description:
“Le Projet « Ecole Pour Tous » a introduit le Paquet Minimum pour fonctionner la Comité de Gestion d'Ecole. Il composé de trois éléments.
1  Elections démocratiques pour créer une structure ouverte et transparente.
2  Elaboration d’un Plan d’action de l’école de manière démocratique.
3   Suivi du fonctionnement des Comités de Gestion d’Ecole pour leur pérennisation.
 Le JICA appui des activités de la Comité de Gestion d'Ecole par le projet « Ecole Pour Tous » en Niger, Sénégal, Burkina Faso, Mali, Côte-d'Ivoire et au Madagascar.

title: [Coopération JICA en éducation(2/6)] Développement scolaire à travers la participation communautaire
description:
Le Projet « Ecole Pour Tous » qui a commencé au Niger. Quels sont des éléments qui fait fonctionner la Comité de Gestion d'Ecole? Voyons les éléments fondamentaux et le model pratique.
Le JICA appui des activités de la Comité de Gestion d'Ecole par le projet « Ecole Pour Tous » en Niger, Sénégal, Burkina Faso, Mali, Côte-d'Ivoire et au Madagascar.

title: [Coopération JICA en éducation(1/6)] Rêve - « Ecole Pour Tous » ouvre la voie du futur
description:
La République du Niger est connue comme l’un des pays les plus pauvres au monde. En 2004, le taux de scolarisation dans l’enseignement primaire était de 52%, et les filles ne comptaient qu’à peine moins de 40%. Même à l’école, il n’y avait pas assez de salles de classe, les enseignants étaient souvent absents…il ne manquait pas de problème . Les parents d’élèves et les membres de la communauté éprouvaient de plus en plus de méfiance à l’égard de l’éducation scolaire.

En espérant d’avoir un Comité de Gestion d’Ecole fonctionnel…
Le Projet « Ecole Pour Tous » a commencé au Niger en 2004 en visant à effectuer une gestion de l’école avec toutes les personnes qui l’entourent comme les enseignants, les parents d’élèves et les membres de la communauté. Que ce-que des activités de la gestion d'école apporte bon effets aux enfants.....
 Le JICA appui des activités de la Comité de Gestion d'Ecole par le projet « Ecole Pour Tous » en Niger, Sénégal, Burkina Faso, Mali, Côte-d'Ivoire et au Madagascar.

title: 【JICA' Educational Cooperation(5/6)】Model for Effective Use of School Grant
description:
Although various school grant programs are carried out in Africa, they do not seem to have made any impact. How can we use School Grant to improve the quality of learning? The answer is the model for "Effective Use of School Grant" which is part of the "School for All" project. 
JICA has supported the activities in improving school management through “School for All” project since its start-up in Niger, 2004. The project is in place in five African countries, Niger, Senegal, Burkina Faso, Mali, Cote d'Ivoire and will be launched in Madagascar soon.

title: 【JICA' Educational Cooperation(4/6)】Minimum Package for Learning Quality
description:
The reason for the amazing improvement of scholastic ability is the basic improvement model due to resident participation, or “Minimum Package for Learning Quality”. This package is made up of 4 elements: 1)The “scholastic ability test” to grasp the pupils' scholastic ability, 2)Encouragement of community participation by “information sharing with the community” as regards test results, 3) Use of “effective workbooks” to improve scholastic ability, and 4) Ensuring time for “study outside school supported by community”.
JICA has supported the activities in improving school management through “School for All” project since its start-up in Niger, 2004. The project is in place in five African countries, Niger, Senegal, Burkina Faso, Mali, Cote d'Ivoire and will be launched in Madagascar soon.

title: 【JICA' Educational Cooperation(3/6)】Revitalization of School Management Committee
description:
“School for All” project introduced a minimum package for functionalization of School Management Committee that consists of three basic components: 1) Democratic elections to make an organization opened and transparent for everyone, 2) School Action Plan to work out activities democratically, 3) Monitoring so that School Management Committee functions continuously.
JICA has supported the activities in improving school management through “School for All” project since its start-up in Niger, 2004. The project is in place in five African countries, Niger, Senegal, Burkina Faso, Mali, Cote d'Ivoire and will be launched in Madagascar soon.

JICA has supported the activities in improving school management through “School for All” project since its start-up in Niger, 2004. The project is in place in five African countries, Niger, Senegal, Burkina Faso, Mali, Cote d'Ivoire and will be launched in Madagascar soon.

title: 【JICA' Educational Cooperation(1/6)】Dream "School for All" opens the way to the future
description:
West Africa has no notable resources, and there are many countries which are less-developed. The Republic of Niger is one of the poorest countries in the word. In 2004, the enrollment rate of primary education was 52%, and girls accounted for less than 40% of those pupils. At school, there are problems like lack of classrooms, and absence of teachers.　Parents and the community lost their faith in school education.
JICA has supported the activities in improving school management through “School for All” project since its start-up in Niger, 2004. The project is in place in five African countries, Niger, Senegal, Burkina Faso, Mali, Cote d'Ivoire and will be launched in Madagascar soon.

description:

JICA has supported the activities in improving school management through “School for All” project since its start-up in Niger, 2004. The project is in place in five African countries, Niger, Senegal, Burkina Faso, Mali, Cote d'Ivoire and will be launched in Madagascar soon.

description: JICA is supporting forest preservation effort in India for the past 25 years. Uttarakhand, the north district in India, is one of the most ecologically rich states but also a disaster-prone area by flooding and landslides. JICA and Uttarakhand Government agreed to conduct a technical cooperation project aims to enhance the system for slope disaster management in the forest areas including capacity building such as future preparedness to fight all kinds of natural disasters and knowledge dissemination to other Himalayan states.
